mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate compresses the discount rate applied to equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 2.5% is followed by positive 20-day returns in less than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 4.0% is followed by negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.5) signals a policy error where the Federal Reserve is not adequately addressing inflation, leading to stagflation risks and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The condition CPIAUCSL > 2.5 AND FEDFUNDS < 2.5 is followed by negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening real estate sector and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in HOUST is not followed by negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 105 is not followed by positive 60-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 200k) indicates a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS above 200k is not followed by positive 5-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1100) combined with weak retail sales (RSAFS < 500000) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The condition HOUST < 1100 AND RSAFS < 500000 is followed by negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In an inflationary environment (CPIAUCSL > 2.5), a high level of consumer price inflation signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In inflationary environments (CPIAUCSL > 2.5), high CPI levels are not followed by negative 60-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
